name: eMoods Bipolar Mood Tracker
one_liner: Free daily mood chart built for bipolar disorder: log lows, highs, irritability, anxiety, sleep and medications, then export a report for your doctor.
best_for: People with bipolar disorder who want a daily mood chart to share with a psychiatrist
People tracking sleep and medication alongside mood to catch early warning signs
People who want mood records kept on their phone without an account
not_for: Anyone in crisis or thinking about suicide: call or text 988
Anyone with signs of mania or psychosis right now: contact your clinician or go to an emergency room
People looking for therapy, coaching or guided exercises
short_description: Bipolar-focused mood chart for depression, elevation, irritability, anxiety, sleep and medications, with shareable reports. Data stays on your phone.
long_description: eMoods, from Empathic Software, is a daily mood chart designed around bipolar disorder. Instead of one mood score, you rate depressed mood, elevated mood, psychotic symptoms, irritability and anxiety, and add sleep hours, medications and notes. It produces a colour-coded monthly view and a report you can send to your clinician, which can help spot early signs of an episode. The developer says the mobile app keeps all data on your device with no registration; exports and optional backups (to your own cloud storage) happen only when you start them. A separate web product, eMoods Insights, stores data in the cloud. eMoods is a self-monitoring tool, not treatment; we found no outcome study of the app in people with bipolar disorder.
patient_summary: Each evening you rate that day's depressed mood, elevated mood, irritability and anxiety, and log sleep hours, medications and notes. eMoods builds a monthly chart and a report you can email or print for your psychiatrist or therapist. The app is free, keeps data on your phone and needs no account; an optional paid upgrade is available.

pricing.notes: Core tracking and reports are free and the developer says original features stay free. An optional Pro upgrade is sold in the app; a 2024 third-party listing showed $1.99/month or $9.99/year, but we could not confirm the current price. eMoods Insights (web, cloud-based) is a separate product.

privacy.notes: Developer says the mobile app keeps data on your device, needs no registration and it cannot access your entries; exports and backups only happen when you start them.

seo.meta_description: eMoods is a mood tracker for bipolar disorder. Track mood episodes, sleep, medications. Generate PDF reports for your doctor.

faqs.q: Is eMoods specifically for bipolar disorder?
faqs.a: Yes. Unlike general mood trackers, eMoods is designed specifically for bipolar disorder. It tracks both depression and elevated mood (mania/hypomania), along with irritability, anxiety, sleep, and medications - all the dimensions important for managing bipolar.

faqs.q: Can I share eMoods data with my psychiatrist?
faqs.a: Yes. eMoods generates PDF reports showing your mood patterns, sleep, and medication adherence over time. Many users bring these reports to psychiatry appointments to help with medication adjustments and treatment planning.

faqs.q: How often should I track my mood in eMoods?
faqs.a: Most users track once daily, typically at the end of the day. Consistent daily tracking gives the most useful data. The app sends reminders to help you build the habit.

No. eMoods is a tracking tool that supports your treatment, not a replacement for it. Bipolar disorder requires professional treatment including medication and often therapy. eMoods helps you and your providers make better treatment decisions.
